source_metadata.exact_title: Initial management of intermediate- and high-risk pulmonary embolism

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom model is explicitly oriented to primary literature, whereas this source is a narrative review.

Quantitative and comparative findings originating in cited studies are represented only as secondary reports from this review, anchored to the review page and tagged secondary_reported_result; they are not primary-study extractions.

Where the review supplied direction or ranges without a point estimate compatible with the QuantitativeResult contract, the claim was retained as a qualitative_result rather than fabricating an estimate.
The bibliography was not atomized; reference entries were treated as provenance infrastructure rather than independent evidence assertions.
The schema has no dedicated recommendation/guideline-synthesis atom kind, so review recommendations were mapped primarily to author_conclusion and tagged to preserve their role.
This extraction does not independently verify the cited primary studies or current guideline text.
schema_gaps: No first-class source-type field distinguishes primary-study atoms from secondary-source synthesis.
No dedicated atom kind for guideline/review recommendations or evidence-synthesis statements.
QuantitativeResult requires a point estimate, which is not ideal for source-reported ranges or threshold-only comparative statements.
